goal: Prevent multiple SummonScout clients from posting periodic WTS summon adverts back-to-back by using observed summon adverts as a peer backoff signal while preserving the existing 200-500 second random cadence and 1 second competitor counter.
notes: Hot-only Lua change. CHAT_MSG_CHANNEL WTS/selling summon adverts from another sender push this client's next periodic advert at least 45 seconds plus a 0-75 second per-character backoff. Later peer adverts may push again so a burst becomes spaced; continuous external seller traffic is capped at a 240 second guard chain to avoid permanent starvation. Own echoed adverts are ignored and the existing counter path is untouched.
